hints.title: Sorting Criteria
hints.text: Sort intervals by starting point in ascending order. When starts tie, sort ends in descending order.

hints.title: Tracking Covered Ends
hints.text: With this sort, any interval that is covered by a previous one must have its end point less than or equal to the maximum end seen so far.

hints.title: Count Non-Covered Intervals
hints.text: Maintain max_end. If current end > max_end, increment the retained count and update max_end.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise comparison takes quadratic time O(N^2), which is unnecessary.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting by start ascending and end descending reduces coverage checks to a single running maximum pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate designs the custom comparator (start asc, end desc) to handle ties cleanly.
complexity.notes: End descending on ties ensures the widest interval comes first.
